craft_notes: Sthāyin: clear-joy. datvā (short a); tataḥ absorbed. Close: water. Rejected: 'holy water' — killed.

lines: Three claps first, sounded strong to clear all bar —
with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye śikhāsaṃkhyātijaptena toyenābhyukṣayettataḥ |

reads_against.argmap: Three claps before having given with sound for obstacle-quelling; topknot-count muttered, with water should sprinkle then.
c1_essence: Three claps sounded; topknot-count water then sprinkled.
